verification.notes: Verified against locally installed kilocode v7.8.27. Top-level interactive TUI accepts -m/--model and --auto. Non-interactive execution uses the `run` subcommand (`kilocode run [message..]`), which defaults to non-interactive (-i/--interactive defaults to false) and accepts -m/--model and --auto. Supports River AI models via river/<provider>/<model> (e.g. 'river/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash', 'river/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8', 'river/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-NVFP4'). River AI models belong exclusively to Kilo Code.

model_passing.notes: Passes River AI models (e.g. 'river/<provider>/<model>') or OpenAI-compatible custom provider models.

non_interactive.notes: Verified via `kilocode run --help`: `kilocode run [message..]` runs non-interactively by default.
